subject: POC plan & exec readout — Auric Health evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@aurichealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aurichealth.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: POC plan & exec readout — Auric Health evaluation

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — really appreciated the candid feedback on latency targets and the integration surface for your clinical search workflows. Per our convo, I pulled together a concise POC plan to make the evaluation as measurable as possible and surface the go/no-go items for your exec review. High level: 2-week POC focused on retrieval-augmented generation for patient note summarization + embeddings for semantic search.

Attached: auric-poc-plan-v1.pdf (outline + technical checklist). I also attached a draft SLA table for the trial (redwood-trial-sla.xlsx).

Proposed POC structure (summary):
- Duration: 14 business days (kickoff: 2026-01-19; readout: 2026-01-26)
- Success criteria (pass if >= 4/5):
  1) Average 95th pct latency for 512-token generation < 250ms (p90 < 150ms)
  2) ROUGE/LU-equivalent summary quality >= baseline threshold on eval set (we’ll include sample prompts)
  3) Embedding recall @10 >= 0.88 on the annotated test queries
  4) No PII exfil issues in data flow review + KMS integration validated
  5) Average cost per 1k tokens within agreed budget band (we’ll provide cost simulation)
- Owners: Redwood technical lead: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.com); Auric technical lead: TBD (please confirm)
- Deliverables: daily rollout notes, automated evaluation script, and final readout slide/deck for execs

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm technical kickoff and Auric technical lead by EOD Friday (2026-01-16)
2) Procurement contact looped in for trial terms (brief non-binding LOI we can sign before kickoff)
3) Schedule exec readout: proposed 2026-01-26, 11:00–11:45 PT (we’ll prepare a 15–20 minute summary + Q&A)

If that all looks reasonable I’ll update the plan and send a calendar invite + DocuSign LOI link.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
[Attachment: auric-poc-plan-v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-trial-sla.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

Thanks Marissa — this is a helpful starting point. A few clarifying Qs from our side before we confirm kickoff: 

1) For the latency numbers, can you confirm whether the 95th/90th percentiles are measured on your hosted environment vs. our private VPC option? For compliance reasons we may need to run in our VPC.
2) On the ROUGE/quality threshold — can you share the eval script and sample prompts so our clinical NLP team can sanity-check?
3) Procurement asked for a brief non-binding LOI and a contact to expect next steps from — I’m looping them in (procurement@aurichealth.com).

Also looped in Tom (CIO) — Tom, are you available for the proposed 01/26 exec readout time? If not, we can propose morning of 01/27 as backup.

Sarah
Head of Data Science | Auric Health
sarah.johnson@aurichealth.com | (415) 777-3344

Thanks Sarah — quick answers inline and updated plan attached.

1) Latency environment: we can run the POC in either Redwood-hosted or in your VPC. For the VPC option we’ll need a short networking checklist and a single engineer for the first day. Measured numbers in the doc are from Redwood-hosted perf profiles; for VPC we’ll run the same benchmark during day 1 and capture comparable percentiles.

2) Eval artifacts: included in auric-poc-plan-v1.pdf is a link to the evaluation script and a sample prompt set. I’ve also attached a lightweight README with the inputs we suggest your clinical NLP team run locally.

3) LOI & procurement: thanks for looping procurement in. I’ve initiated a non-binding LOI via DocuSign (link below) so we can finalize trial terms before the kickoff.

Updated POC notes (high level):
- Kickoff: 2026-01-19, 10:00 PT (technical alignment — 60m)
- Day 1–3: integration & baseline tests (networking + small-scale perf)
- Day 4–10: evaluation runs (summarization + embeddings) + daily automated reports
- Day 11–12: remediation & tuning based on eval results
- Day 13: audit & security signoff (KMS + logs)
- Day 14: final readout prep
- Readout: 2026-01-26, 11:00 PT (15–20 minute summary + Q&A)

Owners (confirmed):
- Redwood technical lead: Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.com) — will own deployment and perf profiling
- Redwood PM: Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) — will own evaluation scripts and post-POC analysis
- Auric technical lead: Sarah (please confirm assignment of an engineer for day 1)

Links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/contact/7654321
- DocuSign LOI (non-binding): https://www.docusign.com/link/intent/AH-LOI-2026

I’ll attach the revised auric-poc-plan-v1.pdf (now v1.1) and the redwood-trial-sla.xlsx with cost scenarios.

If procurement confirms the LOI and Auric provides a technical lead, we’ll send invites and kick off on the 19th.

Best,

Marissa

Thanks Marissa / Sarah — I’ll own the deployment and perf profiling for the POC. A few operational notes for the kickoff: 

- For VPC option: please provide a temporary bastion IP allowlist and a small set of ports (we’ll send exact list) at least 48 hours prior to kickoff.
- We’ll instrument KV-cache metrics and token-level latency tracing; I’ll publish a lightweight dashboard for your team by EOD day 2.
- Can Auric confirm the test dataset location (S3 bucket or secure share)? If S3, we’ll need read-only credentials scoped to the test prefix.

Marissa — I’m available for a technical prep call on 01/18 at 10:00 PT if that helps.
